name: dotLottie
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: .lottie container plus ThorVG WASM canvas player with frame seeking
summary: LottieFiles runtime and container format: .lottie zips animations, images and themes, and dotlottie-web plays them on canvas via a ThorVG WASM renderer. Frames are seekable (setFrame), so a capture harness can step playback deterministically. Distinguishing strength: smaller packaged assets, theming and state machines over plain Lottie JSON.
use_when: Over lottie-web for .lottie packages, themes or state machines
Canvas playback with exact frame seeking for capture
Lottie assets exported from After Effects or LottieFiles
avoid_when: Authoring motion: GSAP or Motion; Lottie only plays finished files

assessment.rationale: Actively maintained (0.81.0 Oct 2026). Adds the compressed .lottie container, theming and state machines, and a ThorVG WASM canvas renderer with frame seeking; lottie-web is the older SVG-first player.
